changes: Compact 107 DIP top stack preserves existing commands and exposes 19 DIP more arrangement height.
Project identity, retained-source playback limitation and selected-event information occupy separate bounded regions.
Empty and retained-source selections show unavailable ordinary timing markers; real zero-valued ordinary events retain numeric zero.
Timeline row-divider ends update when measured viewport width changes. The already-visible ruler corner receives anchoring checks, not a production label change.

Native smoke adds long-name ellipsis/tooltips, layout/state/capture bounds, source/empty disabled invocation checks, divider width and ruler-corner geometry; initial failures retain raw client geometry and PNG.
limitations: Cross-compilation does not establish native geometry or appearance. Actual Windows smoke and image review are required.
Wider window evidence will report its observed width; a constrained display is not claimed to have tested a larger width.
Reference fidelity and full application parity remain unfinished.
